scientific_integrity: The universal proof uses Rayleigh/trace bounds, exact spectral eigen-branches, and a piecewise-linear cost minimization; 3,055 replayed finite checks are supplemental. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem covers a complete two-block graph under linear rate prices; nonsymmetric upper-critical optimizers are not completely classified. General spectral-gap optimization and unpriced complete-graph cases are established prior art. Equivalent explicit specializations may exist in unindexed work.
title: Two sharp price transitions and asymmetric optimal designs for two-community fastest diffusion
